desc:
🦁 Build your dream zoo!
Design habitats, care for your animals, and create a zoo your visitors will love. Start small and grow your collection into a five-star zoo!

🔨 Build your way — customize habitats with plants, rocks, paths, and decorations.
🐾 Collect animals — discover different species and find rare BIG, GIANT, and LEGENDARY sizes!
🍎 Care for your zoo — keep your animals fed and happy, and hire zookeepers to help.
⭐ Reach five stars — improve your zoo and give visitors more to explore.
❤️ Visit other zoos — discover what other players have built and leave your favorites a like!

👍 Enjoying the game? LIKE and FAVORIT to support Zoo Builder Tycoon!!!

💬 Help shape our zoo game! Share your feedback, suggest new animals, and show off your builds in our community Discord server. Find it under Social Links!
